message: You know, when storms roll in, I like to think of it as nature’s way of inviting us to cozy up indoors. I stumbled across a handy little resource from the National Weather Service that shares some great tips for staying safe during floods. It’s comforting to know there are simple steps we can take to turn a potentially stressful situation into a snug day at home. Maybe grab a cup of tea and watch the raindrops dance on the window? ☕
